prompt.name: cookie
prompt.label: war.app AuthToken cookie
prompt.help: In a browser signed in to war.app, open the developer tools, then Application (Storage), Cookies, https://war.app, and copy the value of AuthToken. It is a full-account credential: paste it here only.

steps.title: Paste your war.app session
steps.description: For when war.app's sign-in asks for a captcha the connector cannot answer. The cookie is checked against war.app once and kept as your own secret on this connection; no password is asked or stored. If it stops working, use Sign in on this connection again with a fresh one.
